text: On English (US). Type four keys: bottom-left letter (US z), the key right of T (US y), the key right of L (US ;), the key right of that (US ').
Hold Win, tap Space until Deutsch is selected, let go of Win. (Watch the layout line above.)
Type the same four keys again.
Press Left Alt + Shift once. Then type the same four keys again.
Switch back to English (US) with Win+Space. Type the same four keys again.
